def makeLine(self, length, direction, material):
    p1 = self.action_implementer.turtle_position()
    self.action_implementer.turtle_move(direction=direction, distance=length)
    self.action_implementer.turtle_set_brush(shape=(self.action_implementer.get_line(p1=p1, p2=(self.action_implementer.turtle_position()))))
    self.action_implementer.turtle_stamp(block_type=material)
    self.action_implementer.turtle_push()
    self.action_implementer.turtle_extrude(length=30, direction='U', block_type='ICE')
    self.action_implementer.turtle_pop()

def bigH(self, compass_direction, iterations, step_length, height, material):
    i = self.setSurveyPoint()
    self.action_implementer.reset(position=(i + Vec3(0, 1, 0)), heading_q_str=compass_direction)
    self.action_implementer.turtle_move(direction='F', distance=1)
    self.action_implementer.turtle_set_brush(shape=(self.action_implementer.get_lsystem_shape(axiom='[F]--F', iterations=iterations, step_length=step_length, rules=[self.action_implementer.define_rule(predecessor='F', successor='@[+F][-F]')])))
    self.action_implementer.turtle_extrude(length=height, direction='U', block_type=material)

def makeAFilledBall(self, distance_ahead, radius, shell_material, core_material):
    self.action_implementer.reset(position=(self.action_implementer.get_position()), heading_q_str=(self.action_implementer.get_q_compass_direction()))

    self.action_implementer.turtle_set_brush(shape=(self.action_implementer.get_metric_ball(radius=(radius - 1), metric='euclidean')))
    self.action_implementer.turtle_stamp(block_type=core_material)
